title: Optimize Guardrails: add gating health + outcomes dashboards and alert rules
author: Allison Grant
release_notes: Adds Grafana dashboards and alerting rules for Optimize Guardrails gating (pass rate, failure reasons, eval job latency/queue depth, SLO error budget burn, and override usage).
body:
Summary: This PR adds first-pass dashboards and alert rules for the new Optimize Guardrails gating flow. The goal is to make gating outcomes actionable for oncall (runner health, backlog, timeouts) and measurable for product (pass/fail/override rates, failure reasons). This is intended to be used during Phase 2 pilot and carried into GA with follow-up tuning.

Context / why: Optimize can apply cost optimizations (batching/caching/quantization/routing) that can materially impact response quality. With gating enforced at apply time, we need: (1) service health panels for the eval runner + gating pipeline and (2) outcome panels to understand pass/fail/timeout/override behavior and correlate to incident risk.

What’s included:
- New dashboard: "Optimize Guardrails — Gating Overview" (outcomes)
  - Gating pass rate (stacked: pass/fail/timeout) by tenant tier and by optimization_type
  - Failure reason top-N (policy_reason) with drilldown to model_family and suite
  - Override usage rate and absolute counts (with "override_approved" dimension when present)
  - Time-to-decision (end-to-end) p50/p95, broken down by async vs cached results
- New dashboard: "Optimize Guardrails — Eval Runner Health" (operations)
  - Queue depth and job age (max and p95)
  - Job latency histogram (p50/p95/p99) by suite_name
  - Worker saturation (active workers / concurrency limit) and retry rate
  - Error rate split by error_class (timeout, infra, harness, bad_input)
- New dashboard: "Optimize Guardrails — SLO / Error Budget" (SRE)
  - Burn rate (1h / 6h) for gating decision availability SLO
  - Timeouts as a ratio of gating attempts (separate from hard errors)
  - Alert annotations and links to runbook sections

Alerts added (PrometheusRule):
- OptimizeGuardrailsEvalBacklogHigh: queue depth above threshold for 10m OR oldest_job_age_seconds > threshold (warn -> page)
- OptimizeGuardrailsGatingTimeoutRateHigh: timeout ratio > 2% for 15m (warn) and > 5% for 10m (page) scoped to prod
- OptimizeGuardrailsSLOBurnFast: multiwindow burn (1h>14.4 & 6h>6) for gating availability SLO
- OptimizeGuardrailsOverrideSpike: override_count rate spikes above baseline (warn only) to catch policy false positives or customer pressure events

Metric assumptions / dependencies:
- Uses newly emitted metrics from control plane and runner (names as implemented in ENG-3918/ENG-3919):
  - redwood_optimize_gating_decisions_total{result=pass|fail|timeout, tenant_tier, optimization_type, model_family}
  - redwood_optimize_gating_decision_latency_seconds_bucket{path=cache|async, suite_name}
  - redwood_optimize_gating_failures_total{policy_reason, suite_name, model_family}
  - redwood_optimize_gating_overrides_total{approved=true|false, tenant_tier}
  - redwood_eval_runner_queue_depth, redwood_eval_runner_oldest_job_age_seconds
  - redwood_eval_runner_job_latency_seconds_bucket{suite_name}
  - redwood_eval_runner_job_attempts_total{outcome=success|error|timeout, error_class}
- All dashboards are designed to be low-cardinality by default. We intentionally avoid per-tenant panels; dashboards group by tenant_tier and optionally allow filtering on tenant_id via variable (disabled by default; see notes).

Cardinality / safety notes:
- The dashboards default to aggregations that exclude tenant_id and prompt_set_revision.
- A hidden variable exists for tenant_id debugging; it’s behind a toggle annotation and documented as "SRE-only" for incident triage.
- We cap failure reason panels to top 10 to avoid noisy long tails.

Testing / validation:
- Validated dashboards load in staging Grafana and render with synthetic data.
- Ran promtool checks for rule syntax.
- Dry-ran alert queries against last 24h staging metrics; thresholds likely need tuning in pilot.

Screenshots / links:
- Grafana (staging): /d/opt-guardrails-overview, /d/opt-guardrails-runner, /d/opt-guardrails-slo (links in dashboard annotations).
- Runbook references: "Optimize Guardrails Gating Runbook" sections 2 (Backlog) and 4 (Timeouts).

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Threshold tuning: paging thresholds are conservative placeholders pending pilot data (SRE requested revisit after 1 week of pilot).
- Override alerts: currently warn-only; if override becomes a reliability risk we may promote to page with additional context.
- Cost/quality correlation: not included here; will be tracked in product analytics dashboards once post-change quality signals are wired.

Rollout:
- Dashboards will ship to prod Grafana with the next observability-pack deploy.
- Alert rules are scoped to prod and require SRE enablement (rule group is added but initially set to "disabled" in Alertmanager routing; see reviewers’ notes).

Related:
- Linear: ENG-3919 (dashboards/alerts), ENG-3918 (audit/telemetry emits)
- Implementation PRs (redwood): control plane emits + runner metrics and gating enforcement

Review notes / conversation:
- Sean Gallagher (requested changes): Please add oldest job age to backlog panel; queue depth alone misses stuck workers. Also add runbook links directly in alert annotations.
  - Allison Grant: Added oldest_job_age_seconds panel and wired runbook URLs into alert annotations.
- Logan Wright (requested changes): Avoid tenant_id group-by anywhere in default panels; acceptable only as an optional variable. Also ensure policy_reason is bounded (topk) to limit label churn.
  - Allison Grant: Updated all default queries to group by tenant_tier/optimization_type only; tenant_id variable is now hidden and documented. policy_reason panel is now topk(10).
- Rafael Mendes (comment): For burn alerts, use multiwindow burn rate approach (1h/6h) consistent with other SLOs.
  - Allison Grant: Updated OptimizeGuardrailsSLOBurnFast to use the standard (1h>14.4 AND 6h>6) pattern; added recording rule for availability.
- Felix Schneider (comment): Can we add a panel for overrides split by approved vs denied? Helps verify RBAC wiring.
  - Allison Grant: Added override split panel (approved=true/false) on Overview dashboard.
